Reveal Overlay

A dark overlay starts covering the image and slides upward on hover/focus, progressively revealing the image beneath like a curtain.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.reveal-overlay{
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hover-effect.reveal-overlay::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
  transform: translateY(0);
  transition: transform 0.5s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hover-effect.reveal-overlay:hover::before,
.hover-effect.reveal-overlay:focus-visible::before{
  transform: translateY(-100%);
}

The ::before starts covering the image and slides up via transform: translateY(0) -> translateY(-100%) on hover/focus, revealing the image beneath. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
